family_constraints.rule: Either merge to a broad book target or prohibit these sibling classes as distractors for one another. Cover style alone does not identify notebook vs book reliably.
Inspect Computer disk (likely housed minidisc). Merge DVD/CD-style disc sprites or prevent CD-vs-DVD questions based on unreadable markings.
Broad calendar target should include all calendar source identities; alternatively exclude calendar siblings as distractors.
Block visually indistinguishable bound-paper subclasses as mutual distractors until visual labels verified.
Merge as envelope for broad envelope questions; red/greeting variations are attributes, not independently distinguishable object types in all styles.
Broad pushpin target should count both or avoid the other as distractor.
Count both for generic microphone target.
Generic camera target can overlap video/movie cameras; use explicit still camera or count all cameras.
When target noun is car, include all qualifying cars or exclude subclass distractors. Taxi/police-car targets can use explicit distinguishing markings.
Generic bus should count minibuses and trolleybuses, or avoid them as distractors.
Avoid making nearly synonymous or viewpoint-dependent rail vehicle classes mutually exclusive without a reference and explicit subtype cue.
Boat/ship is hierarchical; broad questions require a defined eligible set, especially motor boat vs speedboat.
Generic airplane target should include both; arbitrary source scale is not a semantic discriminator.
Generic bird target must include birds from other classes or exclude them as distractors. Specific bird species can coexist when distinguishable.
Chicken is a species-level term spanning adult hens, roosters, and chicks. Specify adult hen / rooster / chick, or include all.
Generic fish includes these subclasses; avoid treating Fish directory as the only possible fish without explicit reference subtype wording.
Rename Bug after image inspection. Generic beetle includes lady beetles; include both or block near relatives as distractors.
Cow/ox may be indistinguishable by intended sex or use; avoid mutual distractors unless image cue and target wording are clear.
Use explicit four-leaf vs three-leaf clover or merge under clover; distinguish using actual visible leaf count.
Broad tree target includes all; Christmas decoration does not stop an evergreen from being a tree.
Generic blossom/flower target overlaps named flowers. Use a visual subtype label or count all flower classes.
Generic cake can include slices and cupcakes. Name the intended unit/subtype or define all accepted classes.
Ice cream vs soft ice cream is nested; do not rely on category IDs to reject valid ice-cream matches. Shaved ice may visually resemble a sundae.
High Contrast can remove identifying color cues. Verify these remain distinguishable or do not co-sample visually equivalent sources.
A broad meat target includes all, but explicit steak/drumstick questions can separate them.
Do not ask broad shoe and count only one source class. Avoid wearer-gender categories without visible object-level distinctions.
